privacy.title: Private beta privacy notice (draft)
privacy.intro: TechSync CRM is preparing an invite-only, free private beta. This notice describes the intended core service. Operator details and the operational launch checks must be completed before real customer data is accepted.

body.text: The core beta stores account information, workspace membership and permissions, and CRM records and files supplied by invited users.

items: Account and workspace information includes your name, email, sign-in credentials, role and workspace settings.
Customer data includes leads, contacts, companies, deals, activities, tasks, form submissions and imported files.
Operational records include security and activity logs, delivery state and limited request information needed to run and troubleshoot the service.
Provider connections are unavailable until separately accepted. The free core beta has no payment checkout.
To authenticate users and apply workspace access permissions.
To store and display CRM records, capture form submissions, process imports and exports, and deliver requested service messages.
To investigate service failures and security incidents, and handle authorized support and data requests.

body.text: Provider integrations are not included in the core private beta until separately accepted. If a Gmail sending pilot is offered, its consent screen must identify the send-only access requested. Inbox or reply synchronization is not promised by send-only access.

The intended hosting uses a Vercel frontend, a VPS API and worker, and Supabase database and private object storage. The currently inventoried Supabase project is in Frankfurt, Germany (eu-central-1). No India-only residency, certification, recovery guarantee or security guarantee is offered. Access to CRM data depends on workspace roles; authorized operators also need access to operate and recover the service.

Infrastructure and delivery providers process data needed to operate the service. The final list, operator identity and contractual arrangements must be supplied before a business is invited to use real data. We do not claim to be certified against a security or privacy standard.

Use the contact supplied with your invitation to request access, correction, export or removal. During the private beta these requests are handled manually after checking your authority. A completed privacy request requires confirmation from the operator; no automatic or fixed-time completion guarantee is offered.

Facebook and other provider connections are unavailable in the core private beta. If a separately accepted connection already exists, its disconnect and provider deletion-request routes remain available. A connection deletion does not erase unrelated CRM records; request workspace data removal separately.
Essential cookies support sign-in and connection security. The core private beta does not require optional analytics.

CRM record deletion normally moves a record to a 30-day recycle window before scheduled permanent record cleanup. Closing a workspace currently disables access first; complete workspace and object removal requires the operator-run removal procedure. A final retention schedule for logs, files and independently retained backup copies must be agreed and verified before real customer use. No automatic 90-day workspace-erasure promise is made.

The invitation must identify the responsible operator and the contact for support and privacy requests. A public support/privacy inbox and response hours are not yet configured. Do not submit real business or personal data until those details are provided.

terms.title: Private beta terms (draft)
terms.intro: These draft terms describe a free, invitation-only private beta of TechSync CRM. The responsible operator and final reviewed terms must be identified in the invitation before real customer use.

body.text: You must provide accurate information when creating an account and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for all activity under your account and for your users' compliance with these Terms.

The private beta is free and accepts approved businesses by invitation. There is no paid checkout or paid service commitment in this release. Displayed plan names or feature limits do not create a subscription or payment obligation. Any later paid service requires separate accepted terms and billing setup.
You agree not to use TechSync to send unsolicited bulk messages, violate WhatsApp or email provider policies, store unlawful content, or attempt to disrupt or reverse-engineer the service.

You are responsible for having authority to upload and use the data you put into TechSync. During the beta, authorized workspace owners can request a workspace export and removal through the operator-run procedure. The operator must confirm completion and account for files, connection data and retained copies.

This is a limited private beta without a service-level commitment. Features may be unavailable or change. Automated monitoring, backups and recovery procedures require operational verification before the beta opens; recovery-time or data-loss targets are not guarantees.

You may ask the operator to close access, provide an export and remove workspace data after authority checks. Account or workspace closure does not by itself prove that all records, objects, credentials and retained copies have been erased. The operator must confirm completion of the removal procedure.

Final liability, jurisdiction and other contractual provisions require review for the actual operator and intended businesses before real customer use. This draft is not evidence that those launch requirements have been accepted.

The responsible legal operator, jurisdiction and reviewed terms must be confirmed before real businesses are invited. This draft does not name an unverified company or address. Contact the person who supplied your invitation for those details.
